title: patrinia scabiosifolia f. hispida
intro: Patrinia scabiosifolia f. hispida, commonly known as the downy patrinia, is a perennial plant species in the family Valerianaceae, native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Patrinia scabiosifolia f. hispida include reducing fever, relieving pain and swelling, and treating various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
